Норэльгестромин C21H29NO2 = 327.5. CAS — 53016-31-2. Profile Norelgestromin is a progestogen (see Progesterone, p.2125); it is the primary active metabolite of norgestimate (p.2121). Nore- lgestromin is used as the progestogenic component of a com- bined contraceptive transdermal patch. A dose of 150 micrograms of norelgestromin is released daily with ethi- nylestradiol.
